public_rationale: Pre-post research already described exact guarantees for specified constraints in generative systems. That is material counterevidence to a literal claim that no physical constraints can ever be guaranteed. But these methods do not guarantee broad physical correctness, truthfulness, or object permanence in general-purpose outputs. The contextual reading is therefore not settled, and treating narrow guarantees as decisive would make the result depend on an unstated scope choice.
limitations: Restricted mathematical guarantees and broad semantic guarantees have different scopes.
Evidence that ordinary generations fail cannot prove that every enforcement method is impossible.
The cited methods do not establish that Sora itself offered these guarantees.
